# Public-data correspondence for situated recovery / 情境恢复的公开数据对应

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`situated-recovery-empirical-correspondence` · **reviewed-scoped** · assessment · F04 · [record](situated-recovery-empirical-correspondence.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Public records from 16 participants support finite mean response retention and constrain the predictive scope of simple temporal curves; greater model complexity is not uniformly superior.
>
> 16位参与者的公开记录支持有限阶段内的平均反应保留，并限制简单时间曲线的预测适用范围；较复杂模型没有普遍胜出。

## Conditions / 条件

- Use the author-provided force-compensation coefficient, FieldA direction and actual trials; the complete original processing has not been independently reproduced exactly.<br>采用作者提供的施力补偿系数、FieldA方向及实际试次；作者的完整原始处理未被独立精确重建。
- Eight participants per group; resample participants and reserve final 50 observations for scoring. Published findings were known, making this exploratory secondary analysis.<br>两组各8人；以参与者为重采样单位，最后50次观察仅用于预测评分；该次分析已知论文结论，属探索性复算。
- Descriptive curves, baseline and extrapolation rules are explicit; the nonnegative-level constraint is a post hoc sensitivity preserving the original results.<br>描述性曲线、基线及外推规则明示；非负水平约束是保留原结果后的事后敏感性分析。

## Does not show / 未表明

- Retention is supported over finite stages; no infinite-time limit is established.<br>所支持的是有限阶段内的保留，未建立无限时间极限。
- The curve comparison does not establish a unique mechanism.<br>曲线比较未建立独占机制。
- Mean response retention does not establish complete situational understanding or ethical convergence.<br>平均反应保留未建立完整情境理解或伦理收敛。
- It does not establish joint cross-scale biological validation.<br>未建立跨尺度生物联合验证。
- **Counterexample / 反例:** The baseline-corrected group-difference interval includes zero; simple decay wins mean spontaneous forecast error and a constant mean wins evoked error. Near-unit parameter instability and force reconstruction differences are retained.<br>基线校正后的组间区间包含零；自发组简单衰减、诱发组恒定均值的平均预测误差最低。近单位参数不可识别及施力复算差异均保留。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/inquiry-correspondence/situated-recovery/README.md)

## Progress / 已接通

1. Public data: all 16 original recovery records are analysed at participant level, extending the six-study synthesis with actual measurement correspondence and held-out forecast evaluation.<br>公开数据：全部16位参与者的原始恢复记录按参与者分析，在六篇文献整合之上加入实际测量对应与留后预测评估。 [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/JOINT-RISK-REVISION-INTEGRATION.md#41-public-records-now-test-a-specific-correspondence)

## Evidence / 证据

18 original files retained; 16 MAT files match deposited hashes; 5,440 rows, 2,656 measurements and 800 held-out predictions pass data and arithmetic checks. Substantive self-review completed; no independent experiment, independent-agent review or new Lean theorem.<br>18个来源文件保存；16份MAT核对官方哈希；5,440行、2,656次测量、800次留后预测通过数据与算术检查。实质自审完成，无独立实验、独立agent审查或新Lean定理。

## Next / 下一步

Reuse the completed measurement correspondence. Stronger mechanism claims require discriminating experimental relations or existing intervention evidence, rather than waiting for our own laboratory.<br>复用已完成的测量对应；更强机制主张须借有区分力的实验关系或既有干预证据检验，不重复等待自建实验室。
